facts.event: 孔林（Conrin）的灰衣党羽倒戈，蒂尔德拔矛高呼护王，随后镶砖墙里突然涌出十五名藏匿的灰衣人。
facts.relation: Conrin 与 Tilde 敌对；灰衣党羽是 Conrin 的伏兵
facts.anchor: a panel in the tiled wall burst open, spilling out fifteen men in grey

facts.event: 孔林直取父王利兰（Liran），奥顿（Odon）横身挡在中间，把年轻的孔林连人带剑击退。
facts.relation: Odon 护主 vs Conrin 弑父；二人非父子但以命相搏
facts.anchor: Odon stood between him, and in a breath he was charging into the young swan, batting his blade aside

facts.event: 盖萨（Gaisa）挥剑扑向阿拉尔（Alar），埃吉尔（Egil）扑上去把盖萨从兄长身上扯开。
facts.relation: 三兄弟 Alar / Gaisa / Egil 自相残杀；Egil 摇摆后选边
facts.anchor: threw himself bodily at Gaisa, tearing him away from Alar while their older brother laughed

facts.event: 佩林（Perin）率绿卫入场，却在罩袍上涂了红痕，手里提着阿德玛公爵（Ademar）的头颅，声称“兄长出价更高”。
facts.relation: Perin 背叛 Tilde 与 Ademar，转投 Alar
facts.anchor: I saw the captain was carrying Ducal Ademar’s head in his hand

facts.event: 佩林逼近逼降，蒂尔德以矛格开其剑；随后埃莉丝（Elise）两箭射穿佩林后背与咽喉，黑衣战士高喊“For Isen”入场。
facts.relation: Elise 救 Tilde 并倒向 Isen 一派；Tilde 与 Perin 决裂
facts.anchor: He stumbled, the feathers of an arrow shaft sprouting from his back.

facts.event: 蒂尔德挺矛从背后刺穿特德默（Thedemer），马洛琳（Marolyn）补上一刀自其下巴贯入颅侧。
facts.relation: Tilde 与 Marolyn 联手杀 Thedemer；Marolyn 护卫 Tilde
facts.anchor: charging into Thedemer and skewering him through while his back was turned

facts.event: 利兰抓住阿拉尔的头颅，把他整个人摔向地面并反复砸向瓷砖，将长子杀死。
facts.relation: Liran 杀亲子 Alar；Elise 目睹后尖叫
facts.anchor: throwing his son by the skull to the floor and slamming his head into the tile

facts.event: 蒂尔德下令乌特伦（Uhtren）送王回寝殿并召医师齐扬（Ziyan），逮捕灰红两派，众贵族跪拜，唯埃莉丝昂首挑战。
facts.relation: Tilde 夺权；Elise 由盟友转为对手
facts.anchor: Arrest the factions wearing grey and red. Arrest all other than my own personal guards.
